index_note: Full 7-email build (E1 to E7), AR and EN. Slotted live-component build. Draft, nothing sends. Offer terms genericized in visible copy pending confirmation; accessibility upgrade applied to the renderer. Hero (E1/E2) and portrait cards verified on CloudFront, stage to Ortto CDN before send.
open_items: Full 7-email build (E1 to E7), AR and EN.

Offer terms GENERICIZED in visible copy (requester decision): E5-E7 no longer show 30%, code SUM30, or the 2026-07-06 date, and the PromoLine is omitted; E2 no longer claims free. On Ahmed's confirmation of the real terms, re-add the percentage/date and the PromoLine code, and restore the E2 free framing + free-chapter deep-link.
E2 currently teases the Smokey Eyes look and links to the class page; the free-chapter unlock and its deep-link are deferred until confirmed.
Hero (E1/E2) and class-card images are CloudFront design proofs; stage to Ortto CDN (m.autopilotapp.com) before any send.

Banners: the autopilot numbered images (1_7/2_7/3_6.png) are REMOVED from E3-E7 (generic carousel art with baked-in Arabic text, never headers, confirmed by the cheatsheet). All of E3-E7 now use the real TEXT-FREE multi-instructor collage (Drive MHT_Playlists_MultiInstructorCollage.png, fileId 1Js6dvb8QeCdp2NIp18OOxixEyH_1-4ml), re-hosted to a public CDN so it renders in the preview and the inbox. The branded 'Learn from Arab Greats' banner (Unipal, fileId 1nskza7QCgQ0mcx1aonv5FhzcaRv5ZZZ4) is the requested second option for E3/E5: its Drive folder is not yet link-public (import hit an auth redirect), so set that folder to anyone-with-link to add it. For send, stage all headers (collage, banner, Bassam cover, the 3 portrait cards) to the Ortto CDN (m.autopilotapp.com) and swap the srcs.

E1/E2 author header is the Bassam class cover on CloudFront (hotlink-protected; renders in maharat context, stage to Ortto to render reliably in inbox). The 3 cross-sell class-card portraits are likewise CloudFront; stage all to Ortto before send.
Send platform OPEN (Ortto not yet adopted); unsubscribe is a platform merge tag wired at send; plain-text MIME part to be supplied by the platform at send.

Accessibility: the shared renderer was upgraded for WCAG AA (semantic h1/h2 headings, ul/li list, lightened footer and fine-print colors, logo link aria-label, promo badge solid fill). Re-verify after render.
Success metric number+date, suppression source, and Saudi PDPL/data-residency remain for the human gate.

emails.name: E1 . Bassam, master the techniques
emails.subject: أتقني تقنيات المكياج، خطوة بخطوة
emails.preheader: يعلّمك بسام فتّوح تقنياته خطوة بخطوة، 20 درساً من الأساسيات حتى اللمسات الأخيرة.
emails.headline: أتقني التقنيات التي تصنع كل إطلالة.
body: مع بسام فتّوح، أحد أشهر خبراء المكياج في العالم العربي، تتعلّمين التقنيات التي يعتمدها المحترفون، خطوة بخطوة، من تجهيز البشرة واختيار الألوان حتى اللمسات الأخيرة.
20 درساً واضحاً وعملياً، يحوّلون المكياج من محاولات إلى مهارة تملكينها.
ابدئي بالدرس الأول اليوم.

emails.name: E1 . Bassam, master the techniques
emails.subject: Master makeup techniques, step by step
subject_alts: The skill behind every great look
emails.preheader: Bassam Fattouh teaches his techniques step by step, 20 lessons from the essentials to the finishing touches.
emails.headline: Master the techniques behind every look.
body: With Bassam Fattouh, one of the most sought-after makeup artists in the Arab world, you learn the techniques the professionals rely on, taught step by step, from skin prep and color to the finishing touches.
20 clear, practical lessons that turn makeup from guesswork into a skill you own.
Start with the first lesson today.

emails.name: E2 . Bassam, perfect the look
emails.subject: أتقني الإطلالة التي تريدينها
emails.preheader: مكياج بلا مكياج، من النهار إلى الليل، السموكي، والغلام الكامل، أتقني كل إطلالة مع بسام فتّوح.
emails.headline: أتقني كل إطلالة، من اليومي إلى الغلام الكامل.
body: حين تتقنين التقنية، تأتي الإطلالة. يأخذك بسام فتّوح إلى الإطلالات نفسها: مكياج بلا مكياج، من النهار إلى الليل، السموكي، والغلام الكامل.
كل إطلالة مشروحة خطوة بخطوة، لتصنعيها بنفسك بثقة، لأي مناسبة.
شاهدي الإطلالات في الدورة.

emails.name: E2 . Bassam, perfect the look
emails.subject: Perfect the look you want
emails.preheader: No-makeup makeup, day to night, the smokey eye, full glam, perfect each look with Bassam Fattouh.
emails.headline: Perfect every look, from everyday to full glam.
body: Once you have the technique, the look follows. Bassam Fattouh takes you through the looks themselves: the no-makeup makeup, day to night, the smokey eye, and full glam.
Each one broken down step by step, so you can recreate it yourself, with confidence, for any occasion.
See the looks in the masterclass.

emails.preheader: Why buy one masterclass when one subscription opens all of them? Start any skill, any time, at your own pace.
